verdict: Organic engagement softening across all three locations; paid channels inactive.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, the last 28 days produced 388 combined Google Business Profile actions — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — entirely from organic activity, as paid advertising ran at zero spend on both Meta and Google Ads for the full period. GBP engagement is declining at all three locations this week: O'Hare down 69%, Advance Grinding down 25%, and Forte Metals down 17% compared to the prior seven days, a pattern that points to softening local search visibility rather than any single isolated event. Work is underway to identify and address the visibility root cause, with a fix targeted by end of August. CRM setup milestones from July are being closed out so that inquiries arriving through organic channels are captured and tracked properly going forward.
